verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Oneleet continuously monitors AWS, GitHub, and Google Workspace configuration, and turns results into findings you can triage, assign, and resolve inside the platform. Nothing in the pack shows those control failures or drift being pushed to Slack, email, or a ticketing system, which is the core of this story. Continuous-monitoring alerting is a fair axis for a compliance platform, so the absence of evidence means none, not na.
